name: jev-client
description: Call TypeSafe Jev (System One API) from the Swift jev-client command and register TypeSafe or OpenAI API keys in the macOS Keychain. Use for explicit Jev or TypeSafe requests: typed yes/no, choice or score judgments with probabilities, listing models, or checking and saving API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Ask TypeSafe Jev typed questions and manage API keys
interface.longDescription: Call TypeSafe Jev (System One API) from the Swift jev-client command and register TypeSafe or OpenAI API keys in the macOS Keychain. Use for explicit Jev or TypeSafe requests: typed yes/no, choice or score judgments with probabilities, listing models, or checking and saving API keys. The runtime is built from tools/jev-client; the Plugin installs no app, hook or MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use $jev-client to ask Jev these typed questions about the evidence and return the answers with probabilities.
